purpose: Fresh read-only DATA audit of four DEV label corrections, their three rebalanced selections and 49 unaffected family pairs.

scope.sourceInputPolicy: Only the three authorized DEV source pools, explicit curator outputs and final selections/backups; receipts, selector/packer, collection metadata and public schema/loader. Other family pairs are raw-byte comparisons and programmatic counts/schema/snippet validation only.
scope.protectedProcessing: Holdout writing, individual judgments, snippets and passage IDs stay in the local validator process. The report contains pair metadata/hashes and family aggregates only.
scope.independentReviewer: Not invoked: the user prohibited delegation. This is the requested fresh incremental auditor.
scope.semanticBoundary: Correction transport, preserved data, control retention and deterministic selection are verified. Curator reasons and actions are matched as data; independent semantic-review claims are outside this DATA audit.

priorFreeze.relationship: Prior freeze coverage is inherited through exact baseline hashes for 49 unchanged pairs. This audit independently checks the three changed DEV collections and reruns only the permitted family validator/counts/uniqueness checks. Prior assertion counts are excluded from assertionCount.

assertionCounting: One count per direct invocation of check() in the hashed verifier. Group counts sum to assertionCount. Each successful public readDocument() call counts once; its internal assertions and the prior freeze assertions are excluded.

corrections.reason: The packaging requirement supplies a particular search in the garage; missing cardboard and substitute wrapping resolve it.
Delayed collection accommodates the ongoing toast without interrupting it.
The delay allows Dad an opportunity to complete his ongoing attempt before intervention.
The adjoining sentence supplies a concrete visual observation of dust on scales in the room surveyed; observation itself needs no later task.

selectorProof.sideEffectBoundary: The in-memory module ends before function main(); no selector/packer CLI was executed. Only retention and select were invoked for the three authorized DEV jobs.
selectorProof.independentComparison: Independent mandatory flags and SHA-256 ordering reproduce all selected rows in exact order. Mixed-quota enumeration uses free cells 000/001/010/100; selector uses 011/101/110/111. Exhaustive feasible counts prove the first feasible radius, minimum L1 and lexicographic tie break.
selectorProof.selectionInputs: Source labels and explicit curator/source records determine controls and quotas; rank uses SHA-256 of split/raw ID. Detector predictions and model scores are never read by the invoked selector operations.
selectorProof.selectedRowProvenance: All 600 selected rows match their source rows; all 727 source rows and complete labels match the Git full-pool archive.

completion: The four DEV corrections, three final selections, complete 727-row source archive and 49 unchanged pairs satisfy the stated incremental DATA audit assertions.
